## Tours visiting the Enchanted Aquarium: what's included?

**The Enchanted Aquarium (Aquário Encantado) is a natural pool, not an urban aquarium.** It lies near [Bom Jardim](/brazil/place/bom-jardim/) in Mato Grosso state. Water rises from natural springs, allowing visitors to see fish and underwater plants. People come here to snorkel and observe wildlife in its natural environment.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. On every one of these itineraries, visiting the [Enchanted Aquarium](/brazil/place/aquario-encantado/) is part of the main journey. The pool itself, however, occupies only a portion of the trip: some routes continue to jaguar habitats in the [Northern Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/), while others combine it with tropical forest or [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/).

To choose between them, it is more useful to compare **what happens after snorkeling** than to read the same description of clear water. If wildlife observation is your priority, look at how many days are spent in the Pantanal. If you want several ecosystems or a city finale, select the corresponding extension.

## Comparing the three itineraries

| Tour | Main difference |
|---|---|
| [Northern Pantanal, 5 days](/brazil/tour/northern-pantanal-waterfalls-rivers/) | Focus on nature observation |
| [Pantanal and Rio, 8 days](/brazil/tour/northern-pantanal-waterfalls-rivers-rio-de-janeiro/) | Rio after the safari |
| [Three Ecosystems, 8 days](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) | Amazon, Cerrado and Araras Lodge |

### Five days: clear water, waterfalls and jaguars

The ["Northern Pantanal: Waterfalls and Rivers" itinerary](/brazil/tour/northern-pantanal-waterfalls-rivers/) begins with a drive from Cuiabá to Bom Jardim. Day one includes a walk to the Enchanted Aquarium and the [Salobra River](/brazil/place/salobra-river/), where around 2 hours are allocated to snorkeling. The route then continues to [Chapada dos Guimarães National Park](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes-national-park/), known for sandstone cliffs, canyons and waterfalls.

The second part of the trip travels through the [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/) to [Porto Jofre](/brazil/place/porto-jofre/). The program focuses on jaguar observation, with a full day devoted to searching and another morning safari. A sighting of a particular predator cannot be guaranteed, but the locations and time allocated make this tour different from a general wetlands sightseeing drive.

This option suits travelers who want to devote the entire trip to nature and are prepared for early starts, changes of base and an active schedule.

### Eight days: Northern Pantanal and Rio de Janeiro

The [eight-day tour ending in Rio](/brazil/tour/northern-pantanal-waterfalls-rivers-rio-de-janeiro/) also begins in Bom Jardim. Snorkeling in clear water, Chapada dos Guimarães and Northern Pantanal excursions remain in the itinerary. After the morning safari on day five, travelers fly to Rio.

The ending changes the trip: instead of more wildlife excursions, there are Sugarloaf Mountain, Corcovado, beaches and free time in a large city. Unlike the five-day option, this adds a domestic flight and another climatic region. When comparing prices, check whether the required air tickets are included in the particular offer.

Choose this route if you are visiting Brazil for the first time and want to combine wildlife observation with Rio's best-known views.

### Eight days: Amazon, Cerrado and Pantanal

The ["Three Ecosystems in 8 Days" tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) is organized differently. The journey starts in the southern Amazon: forest trails, canoeing, the Claro River and the Anaconda Lake area. On day three, travelers head to Bom Jardim for the Enchanted Aquarium and a water excursion with snorkeling, then continue to Chapada dos Guimarães.

The final nature section is in the Northern Pantanal, with **3 nights at [Araras Eco Lodge](/brazil/place/araras-eco-lodge/)**. The itinerary includes canoeing, trails, lookout towers, horseback riding and a night drive. This route is for travelers who want to compare different natural regions rather than concentrate their time on searching for jaguars near Porto Jofre.

The two eight-day journeys have the same duration but very different content. One ends in a large city; the other offers several nights among the Pantanal wetlands.

## What a visit to the natural Aquarium involves

On Ada Tours itineraries, the water activity includes a short walk to the spring and the [Salobra River](/brazil/place/salobra-river/). Travelers put on snorkeling equipment and observe fish near the water surface. This is **swimming with a mask and snorkel, not scuba diving**.

The descriptions of the five- and eight-day Northern Pantanal routes allocate approximately 2 hours to snorkeling. This is the time for the day's water program, not necessarily two uninterrupted hours in one pool. The final sequence depends on arrangements and site conditions.

The Nobres municipal tourism portal lists Aquário Encantado as a natural spring in the Vila Bom Jardim area. Local operators arrange water activities through a tourist voucher system, with limits on visitor capacity. Independent travelers should book ahead. On an organized tour, check which tickets, equipment and local guide services are expressly included.

The water is clear thanks to the spring's natural conditions. Fish observations depend on their behavior and the state of the pool, so photographs showing many fish do not guarantee the same scene at every moment.

## Geography: where Bom Jardim is and why the Pantanal is nearby

[Bom Jardim](/brazil/place/bom-jardim/) is in the Nobres area of Mato Grosso state. It is a different region from the better-known Bonito in Mato Grosso do Sul. Both are associated with clear water but have different airports, roads and travel routes.

Our journeys start in [Cuiabá](/brazil/place/cuiaba/). Travelers head from there to Bom Jardim's water attractions, then to [Chapada dos Guimarães](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes-national-park/) and onward via [Poconé](/brazil/place/pocone/) into the Northern Pantanal. This allows them to see varied landscapes over several days, but requires driving between locations.

If Pantanal wildlife is your overriding interest, also browse [nature and wildlife tours in Brazil](/interests/wildlife/tours/brazil/). Some itineraries in that catalog spend more time on safari and do not include Bom Jardim's water excursion at all.

## Preparing for the water activity

Bring swimwear, a towel and dry clothes for the onward drive. Requirements for masks, flotation vests and other gear are set by the natural attraction and the organizer. Check these along with any age or medical restrictions specified at booking.

A day generally combines several stages: road travel, a short walk, time in the water, lunch and the onward drive. Do not plan extra independent activities on top of an already busy program without checking its schedule.

Follow the local guide's instructions, protect underwater plants and do not feed or catch fish. Quiet observation allows the animals to behave naturally and helps keep the experience enjoyable for future groups.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is the Enchanted Aquarium an ordinary aquarium?

No. It is a natural spring with fish and clear water near Bom Jardim. Visitors experience it outdoors while snorkeling, rather than in indoor aquarium halls.

### Which tours visit the Enchanted Aquarium?

It features on the [five-day Northern Pantanal route](/brazil/tour/northern-pantanal-waterfalls-rivers/), [its eight-day extension ending in Rio](/brazil/tour/northern-pantanal-waterfalls-rivers-rio-de-janeiro/) and the [eight-day Three Ecosystems journey](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/). These are different programs sharing one stop in Bom Jardim.

### Do you need scuba gear?

No. Our itineraries feature snorkeling: observing fish with a mask and snorkel. This differs from scuba diving with tanks and specialist training.

### Does the five-day tour guarantee a jaguar sighting?

No. It includes excursions around [Porto Jofre](/brazil/place/porto-jofre/) for wildlife observation, but jaguars are wild animals. The safari route depends on conditions and the outcome is never guaranteed.

### How do the two eight-day tours differ?

["Pantanal and Rio"](/brazil/tour/northern-pantanal-waterfalls-rivers-rio-de-janeiro/) adds Rio's city sights and beaches. ["Three Ecosystems"](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) instead combines Amazon forest, Cerrado and 3 nights at Araras Lodge in the Pantanal.

## Aquiraz, Brazil: Ceará beaches and Beach Park

Aquiraz is on the coast of Ceará state near Fortaleza. Holidays here revolve around broad Atlantic sandy beaches, coastal hotels and water attractions. The best-known visitor area is **Porto das Dunas**, home to the **Beach Park** complex with its water park and hotels.

Travelers choose Aquiraz to combine relaxed time by the sea with a full program for adults and children. When planning, distinguish Aquiraz town, the Porto das Dunas beachfront, nearby Prainha and the water park itself: these are different places with different visiting arrangements.

## Porto das Dunas: what the resort area offers

Porto das Dunas is a coastal district with a long sandy shore, open ocean and resort facilities. It is convenient for beach holidays and accommodation close to Beach Park. Wind and surf are noticeable, so the calmness of the sea cannot be judged from a single photograph or hotel's promotional description.

If you plan several days by the ocean, choose accommodation with the exact stretch of beach in mind: walking distance to the shore, access to the sand, restaurants and distance to the attractions may vary considerably. Families with young children should check where swimming is safer in the prevailing sea conditions rather than assuming every part of the exposed Atlantic coast has shallow water.

Aquiraz also has **Prainha**, another place for coastal walks. Include it in your journey to experience a quieter side of local life beyond the main resort complex. Allow for travel, weather and the time you want to spend beside the water when choosing different beaches.

## Beach Park: water park and family fun

Beach Park is in Porto das Dunas within Aquiraz. Its **Aqua Park** offers water slides, pools and relaxation areas. Attractions range in intensity, from family splash zones to tall slides for thrill-seekers.

Not every attraction suits every visitor. Age limits, minimum heights, physical requirements and safety rules depend on the specific slide. With children, check suitable areas in advance and allocate your time so that you do not spend the entire day queuing for the most popular rides.

Beach Park also includes other facilities, but **a water park ticket must not be assumed to include hotel accommodation**, or vice versa. Room rates, entry, meals, transfers and separate activities depend on the offer you select. The park's official website publishes operating days and admission terms, which may change seasonally.

| Day format | Activities |
| --- | --- |
| Beach day | Porto das Dunas and ocean |
| Family day | Beach Park water park |
| Relaxed day | Walks at Prainha |
| Mixed day | Beach in the morning, attractions later |

For families traveling through several regions of [Brazil](/brazil/), Aquiraz can be a convenient stop after cultural or nature stages. The exact sequence of transfers and whether Beach Park is included in the paid itinerary must nevertheless be agreed separately.

## Where to stay: near Beach Park or closer to Fortaleza?

If **the water park and ocean** are your main priorities, consider hotels in Porto das Dunas and neighboring Aquiraz resorts to reduce daily travel. Choose accommodation based on the type of holiday, room category, meals and beach access you want rather than only on association with a famous complex.

Travelers planning to spend most of their time in urban restaurants, museums and shopping areas may prefer to stay in Fortaleza and visit Aquiraz for a day. Allow time for the return drive, especially on weekends and in high season.

Aquiraz is not an island resort: it is part of mainland Ceará's coast. It can readily be combined with flights through Fortaleza Airport, although transfer time depends on your hotel area and current road conditions.

## Weather and beach safety in Ceará

The coast is generally warm, but humidity, wind, waves and rainfall vary by season. Even when it is sunny on land, the ocean may be rough. Check local warnings and the conditions of the specific beach before swimming or taking part in water activities.

Sun exposure is strong on open sandy beaches. A hat, high-protection sunscreen, water and breaks in the shade are particularly useful with children. The same precautions matter in the water park: many areas are outdoors and long queues increase time spent in the sun.

For relaxed beach days, browse our [beach holiday selection](/interests/beach-holidays/); families seeking organized activities may also want to see [family tours](/interests/family-tours/). These collections include relevant current itineraries, but not all of them necessarily visit Aquiraz.

## How many days should you spend in Aquiraz?

**One full day** can be devoted to the water park if you travel from Fortaleza and arrange tickets and transport beforehand. For beach relaxation, unhurried walks and exploring another stretch of coastline, allow several nights. With young children, alternate busy park days with quieter days beside the sea.

The best plan depends on your priorities: attractions, ocean or discovering different parts of Ceará. Ada Tours can help you fit Aquiraz alongside other Brazilian destinations and organize a sensible sequence of flights and stops.

## Frequently asked questions about Aquiraz

### Where is Beach Park located?

On Porto das Dunas beach in Aquiraz municipality, Ceará state. It is on the coast near Fortaleza, not in Rio de Janeiro.

### Is Beach Park suitable for young children?

The park has family zones and different kinds of attractions. Access to individual slides depends on height, age and safety rules; check the park's current requirements before buying tickets.

### Can you stay in Fortaleza and visit Aquiraz for one day?

Yes. This works well if you want to visit the water park without changing hotels. For several beach days, accommodation closer to Porto das Dunas usually eliminates the daily commute.

### Do hotel guests at Beach Park need separate water park tickets?

It depends on the accommodation rate and package. Staying in a hotel does not itself prove that Aqua Park admission is included; check the exact booking terms.

## Tours offering the option of a stay in Aquiraz

[Aquiraz](/brazil/place/aquiraz/) is in Ceará state in northeastern Brazil, near Fortaleza. Its coastal areas are known for long sandy beaches and Atlantic surf. One is Porto das Dunas, home to the Beach Park water park.

Our selection includes {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}} where Aquiraz can be added as **a separately agreed beach holiday alternative**. The resort being mentioned does not mean it is part of the paid base itinerary. On the tour covered here, the choice involves a different destination for the final beach days.

{{catalog.tourTable:tour_source_ekzoticheskij_novyj_god_ru}}

## Which Ada Tours program offers Aquiraz?

The ["New Year in Brazil: Rio, Iguazú and the Amazon" tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-new-year-rio-iguazu-amazon/) lasts **12 days**. It combines New Year celebrations in [Rio de Janeiro](/brazil/place/rio-de-janeiro/), visits to [Iguazú Falls](/brazil/place/foz-do-iguacu/), an Amazon section and time at the beach.

The standard itinerary ends with beach days in [Búzios](/brazil/place/buzios/). The final beach stage can be changed: **choose Aquiraz instead of Búzios**, or another northeastern Brazilian resort. This alters the trip's geography, even though the overall concept—city, waterfalls, Amazon and sea—remains the same.

This choice requires separate agreement on flights, transfers, the specific hotel and the number of nights by the sea. The base tour's price should not be treated as the price of the Aquiraz version without checking.

## How Aquiraz differs from Búzios

Búzios lies on the coast of Rio de Janeiro state and is convenient as a beach extension from Rio. The resort is known for bays and small beaches within one coastal area.

Aquiraz is in the northeast of the country. Its coastline is different: broad sandy spaces facing the open Atlantic, long beaches and well-developed resort facilities at Porto das Dunas. Travelers who value family entertainment as much as the beach can plan water attractions separately.

| Criterion | Aquiraz |
|---|---|
| Region | Ceará state |
| Coast | Open Atlantic Ocean |
| Additional entertainment | Beach Park |

For travelers, the main difference is transport. Aquiraz is an additional destination after the mainland excursions, and the revised route requires proper connections through an airport and to the hotel. A flight to Fortaleza is not automatically part of the original beach itinerary.

## Porto das Dunas and beach holidays

Porto das Dunas is one of Aquiraz's well-known resort districts. It offers both beach time and hotel relaxation. The ocean is exposed, so surf and swimming conditions depend on the weather and exact location.

For a restful beach program, choose comfortable accommodation and time for walks in advance. With children, consider shade, transfer duration and recovery time after busy excursion days.

Aquiraz suits a journey whose last stage is devoted to the sea rather than a string of additional required excursions. After active days in Rio and the Amazon, a calmer finale may be particularly appealing.

## Beach Park: a separate outing during the beach stay

**Beach Park** is in Porto das Dunas. It combines water rides, relaxation areas and family entertainment. To visit, choose a date and check entry conditions as well as age and height limits for the rides.

Being near Beach Park does not mean the water park ticket is automatically included in an Ada Tours holiday. If the water park is a main reason for choosing Aquiraz, discuss it before confirming the final itinerary and hotel.

For family-focused travel, also explore [tours with children](/interests/family-tours/) and compare the overall pace: after several flights and excursions, children may need a full day of rest.

## Arranging the change of beach resort

First decide how many days you want to spend on the coast and which hotel suits you. Then agree on the city from which you will fly to Fortaleza after the preceding stages and how the transfer to Aquiraz will work. Only then can you compare the total prices of the options.

The base itinerary already has its own logistics between Rio, Iguazú, the Amazon and Búzios. Changing the beach destination affects the endpoint and may alter the date or airport of the return flight. **The same total number of days does not imply the same price.**

See other coastal programs in the [Brazil tours catalog](/brazil/tour/) and [beach holidays](/interests/beach-holidays/). We can help fit the Aquiraz option around the actual schedule of the main journey.

## Frequently asked questions about Aquiraz holidays

### Is Aquiraz included in the standard New Year tour?

No. Búzios remains the standard beach finale. Aquiraz is an alternative destination chosen and agreed separately.

### Where is Aquiraz?

On the coast of Ceará state near Fortaleza. Porto das Dunas is one of its well-known resort areas.

### Is Aquiraz suitable for families with children?

Yes. The area has beaches and family attractions including Beach Park. Consider children's ages, swimming conditions and restrictions on individual rides when choosing a hotel and water park.

### Is admission to Beach Park included in the tour price?

Not automatically. The visit must be added to the separately agreed itinerary or tickets purchased under the operator's terms.

### Can you visit both Aquiraz and Búzios on the same journey?

That would require additional days and transfers. On this tour, Aquiraz is **an alternative**, not a second required beach stop.

## Araras Eco Lodge: nature experiences in the Northern Pantanal

Araras Pantanal Eco Lodge is located along the Transpantaneira road in the Northern Pantanal, Mato Grosso state. It is a base for journeys through the wetlands, where days revolve around walks, birdwatching, canoe trips and excursions in search of wildlife.

Unlike a conventional hotel resort, proximity to nature is the main attraction. Visitors spend time beyond their rooms, exploring trails, observation structures and wildlife at different times of day. Animals roam freely, so sightings depend on conditions, not a list of promised species.

## Where is Araras Eco Lodge?

The lodge is in the rural part of Poconé municipality, Mato Grosso state, on the Transpantaneira road. This route crosses the Northern Pantanal, where water, seasonal flooding and open fields shape animal life.

The Pantanal differs from the Amazon's dense tropical forest. Open areas, trees, water bodies and floodplains alternate across the landscape. On one journey, you can watch birds from a tower, travel by canoe and walk along a forest trail.

For the wider natural setting, visit the [Pantanal page](/brazil/place/pantanal/). The journey to the lodge and transfer times should be checked against the precise itinerary and seasonal road conditions.

## Three observation towers and forest trails

The lodge program includes three viewpoints, each offering a different perspective on forests and floodplains.

| Tower | Height |
|---|---:|
| Great Egret Lookout | 12 m |
| Howler Monkey | 25 m |
| Jabiru | 13 m |

Great Egret Lookout introduces visitors to the surrounding area, while the higher Howler Monkey tower provides views across a large expanse of the canopy and nearby terrain. The Rondon Trail leads to Jabiru Tower, a vantage point for watching birdlife and wetlands. Quiet behavior and following the guide's directions are essential: a tower alone cannot guarantee a close view of any particular animal.

Walking trails offer close-up views of vegetation, while viewing platforms reveal the landscape from above. The length and difficulty of walks depend on the day's schedule and ground conditions.

## Canoeing and observation from the water

Water excursions in the Northern Pantanal reach places that are difficult or impractical to explore on foot. Our itinerary includes a canoe outing on the Clarinho River or Corixo watercourse, depending on conditions.

From the water, travelers see vegetation along the banks and observe birds. Some areas are known for giant otters and other river wildlife, but no particular encounter can be promised. Water levels, weather and safety rules determine the actual canoe route.

When photographing wildlife, consider distance and light. A photographic safari, a walk and a canoe trip are different activities; together they reveal various parts of the landscape.

## Horseback riding and a night safari

Another component of a stay at Araras is riding across the floodplain. Horses have long been used on Pantanal farms and for moving through wet terrain, making this a characteristic way to explore the area.

Night drives aim to observe animals more active after dark. Sightings always depend on chance and conditions. Group rules, controlled use of lights under the guide's direction and respect for wildlife matter on these outings.

Not every activity is suitable for every traveler. Consider riding experience, the length of walking sections and any age or health restrictions in the specific operator's offer.

## Araras on an eight-day Ada Tours itinerary

The lodge is the final nature base on the ["Amazon, Savanna and Pantanal: Three Ecosystems in 8 Days" tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/). Before arriving, travelers visit the southern Amazon and Chapada dos Guimarães region. The route then runs through Poconé and along the Transpantaneira.

**Three nights** are scheduled at Araras. Activities include canoeing, the Howler Monkey trail and lookout, horseback riding, the Rondon Trail and evening drives. The last day begins with early wildlife observation before a transfer to Cuiabá Airport.

This schedule offers several days in one place rather than a brief roadside stop. Mornings, afternoons and evenings provide different opportunities for birds and other wildlife.

The starting price for the complete eight-day itinerary is **$5514 per person for 2–3 participants**. This is the price of the entire combined program, not accommodation at Araras alone. Check the tour description for lodging, transfers and excursion terms.

## When to visit and how to prepare

Seasonal changes in water levels are important in the Pantanal. Floodplains look and function differently across the year; access roads, canoe routes and wildlife observations depend on the weather. Consider rainfall and terrain access as well as temperature when planning.

Bring comfortable closed shoes and clothing that protects against sun and insects. Binoculars help with birdwatching from towers. Keep your distance when photographing animals and follow the guide's instructions.

More wildlife and birdwatching journeys appear in the ["Wildlife and Safari" collection](/interests/wildlife/). There is a separate ["Nature" section](/interests/nature/) for scenic travel, while the [Brazil tours catalog](/brazil/tour/) lists the full range of itineraries.

## Frequently asked questions about Araras Eco Lodge

### Where is Araras Eco Lodge?

In the Northern Pantanal, on the Transpantaneira road near Poconé, Mato Grosso state. On Ada Tours' current itinerary, travelers reach it after other natural regions of the state.

### Can you see jaguars or giant otters?

The Pantanal has a rich fauna, but particular encounters cannot be guaranteed. Sightings depend on the route, season and luck.

### Which activities are included on the Ada Tours journey?

The Araras section includes canoeing, walks, observation towers, horseback riding and a night drive. The complete services depend on the chosen itinerary.

### How many nights are spent at Araras?

The eight-day "Three Ecosystems of Brazil" tour allocates three nights at Araras Eco Lodge before the return to Cuiabá.

## Tour visiting Araras Eco Lodge: three nights in the Northern Pantanal

**Choose Araras Eco Lodge if you want several consecutive days observing Pantanal wildlife, returning to one base after each outing.** Water excursions, walking trails, viewing towers and wildlife drives alternate here. Scheduling depends on the weather and condition of the natural routes.

Our catalog contains {{catalog.toursCountPhrase}}. Currently, the [eight-day "Amazon, Savanna and Pantanal: Three Ecosystems" tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) visits [Araras Eco Lodge](/brazil/place/araras-eco-lodge/). The stay and nature activities here account for **3 nights**. This is a substantial portion of the journey, not a brief roadside stop.

Before reaching the Pantanal, the route introduces other natural regions of Brazil: the southern Amazon, Bom Jardim's clear water and Chapada dos Guimarães landscapes. Then the experience changes, as travel between distant regions gives way to several days of observing one area.

## How the eight-day itinerary is organized

| Stage | Activities |
|---|---|
| Days 1–2 | Amazon forest and canoeing |
| Days 3–4 | Snorkeling, cliffs and waterfalls |
| Days 5–7 | Araras Eco Lodge and safaris |
| Day 8 | Journey ends |

### Beginning: the Amazon and Bom Jardim

The journey begins in [Cuiabá](/brazil/place/cuiaba/) and continues to Jardim da Amazônia Lodge. Day two includes forest walks, canoeing on the Claro River and a visit to the Anaconda Lake area. Travelers then go to [Bom Jardim](/brazil/place/bom-jardim/) to see fish in the clear waters of the [Enchanted Aquarium](/brazil/place/aquario-encantado/) and [Salobra River](/brazil/place/salobra-river/).

At [Chapada dos Guimarães National Park](/brazil/place/chapada-dos-guimaraes-national-park/), the focus shifts to waterfalls, sandstone cliffs and viewpoints. This sequence reveals the differences between rainforest, Cerrado savanna and Pantanal floodplains within one journey.

If Bom Jardim's water activities are your main interest, explore the [separate selection of tours visiting the Enchanted Aquarium](/brazil/place/aquario-encantado/tour/). The present eight-day route offers a broader nature itinerary and a longer stay at Araras.

### Day 5: the Transpantaneira drive and first observation tower

After breakfast, the route passes through [Poconé](/brazil/place/pocone/) and along the [Transpantaneira](/brazil/place/transpantaneira/) into the [Pantanal](/brazil/place/pantanal/). Stops for birdwatching and wildlife observation are planned along the road. The drive is an attraction in itself: wetlands, bridges and open areas offer a first look at the floodplain before reaching the lodge.

After checking in and exploring the grounds, guests climb the **12-meter Great Egret Lookout**. An evening walk follows dinner. Light and wildlife activity vary throughout the day, making morning and night observations complementary.

### Day 6: canoeing, Howler Monkey trail and night safari

Day six combines water and land excursions. Travelers take a photographic safari to the Clarinho River, followed by canoeing along wooded banks. Giant river otters live in the area, but sightings depend on chance. The nature program also offers an opportunity to try piranha fishing, although wildlife observation is the day's main focus.

In the afternoon, guests walk the Howler Monkey trail to a **25-meter observation tower** overlooking the wetlands. After dinner, a special vehicle takes the group out to look for nocturnal animals.

See the standalone ["Araras: Canoeing, Forest Trail and Night Safari" excursion](/brazil/araras-eco-lodge/araras-canoe-trek-night-safari/) for the full module. One important detail: if the Sentinela section is inaccessible because of weather or road conditions, the canoe route switches to the Corixo River. **Clarinho and Corixo are alternatives**, so both rivers are not promised on one outing.

### Day 7: horseback riding and Jabiru Tower

The following morning features a horseback ride through Pantanal floodplains. After lunch, travelers follow the Rondon Trail to the **13-meter Jabiru Tower**. In favorable conditions, it may be possible to observe a nest of the large jabiru stork.

The third night at Araras allows different kinds of nature observation to be spread across separate days. There is no need to squeeze canoeing, horseback riding, forest paths and both towers into one short excursion.

## What animals can you see around Araras?

The Pantanal is known for birds, aquatic animals and mammals adapted to seasonal floods. Species observed in the lodge area include herons, jabiru storks, capybaras and giant river otters. Other forest and floodplain animals may appear on trails and evening outings.

Yet **a list of species in a destination description is not a promise of sightings**. Animals move freely, and observation depends on water levels, weather, time of day and individual behavior. For photographers, multiple outings increase the variety of possible images, but no particular species can be guaranteed.

If your main goal is specifically searching for jaguars, compare this program with [tours through Porto Jofre](/brazil/place/porto-jofre/tour/), where some journeys allocate separate river safaris to jaguar observation. The Araras program is broader: birds, floodplains, canoeing, riding and walks around the lodge.

## Why the timing and observation format matter

Canoeing makes it possible to survey riverbanks slowly. Open stretches of the Transpantaneira suit observing large birds and animals beside the water. Observation towers give views down over the treetops and floodplains, while the night safari reveals activity after dark.

That is why spending 3 nights at Araras differs from a short sightseeing drive. Travelers experience several ways of exploring the same ecosystem. More outings also mean physical activity, early starts and the need to follow local guides.

Evaluate the specific activities on the [eight-day tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) alongside accommodation, meals, transfers and admission arrangements. These terms differ by program; the lodge's name alone does not imply a universal "all-inclusive" package.

## What to prepare before traveling

Bring comfortable closed shoes for boat outings and trails, lightweight outdoor clothing and sun and insect protection appropriate to local rules. An extra layer is useful for evening drives. Check equipment and requirements for horseback riding and canoeing with the chosen tour operator.

Weather and water conditions genuinely affect trail and canoe access in these natural areas. A temporary change of river or rearrangement of outings does not necessarily mean the entire itinerary has been canceled: an alternative water route is specifically provided for this excursion. Exact changes are decided according to conditions on site.

## Frequently asked questions

### How many nights are spent at Araras Eco Lodge?

The published [eight-day Three Ecosystems tour](/brazil/tour/brazil-three-ecosystems-8-days/) includes 3 nights. These days include the Transpantaneira, canoeing, towers, riding and a night drive.

### Is Araras Eco Lodge in the Amazon?

No. It is in the Northern Pantanal on the Transpantaneira. The Amazonian portion comes earlier in the same journey; Araras is in a different ecosystem.

### Are outings on both the Clarinho and Corixo rivers guaranteed?

No. On the [Araras canoe excursion](/brazil/araras-eco-lodge/araras-canoe-trek-night-safari/), these are alternative routes. The choice depends on weather and local conditions.

### Can you see a jaguar from the lodge?

Jaguars live in the Pantanal, but a sighting cannot be promised. The current tour through Araras focuses on varied wildlife encounters. For dedicated jaguar searches, consider [Porto Jofre tours](/brazil/place/porto-jofre/tour/).

### Is the journey suitable for travelers who only want to relax at the lodge?

The itinerary is built around active excursions: canoeing, walks, horseback riding, viewpoints and safari. There is time to relax between activities, but much of the experience comes from exploring nature.
